item.description:
<h2>0.2.1</h2>

<ul>

<li>Keyboard shortcuts that share your dictation modifier (Ctrl+C with Left Control, Cmd+C with Right Command) no longer start phantom recordings, and two shortcuts in a row no longer enable hands-free mode silently.</li>

<li>Live transcription preview while you speak, with a microphone-level indicator and a "no sound detected" hint.</li>

<li>Recognition language control: Automatic plus 29 languages; interface is now fully in English; the dictionary learns terms from your corrections.</li>

</ul>
